title: 'travel to a known place' only fast-travels between an unstated subset of 'landmark' rooms, not every room visited; which rooms qualify is never explained, so retracing multi-room corridors (Fenmarch's inner fen, Hollowbrook's downs) by hand was frequently necessary despite having 'visited' every tile already.
